programme.desc: S1 E1 — Episode 1 Steve and Neil help a man having a debilitating panic attack at work; Loz and Dan answer a call in the middle of the night to help a woman with agonizing chest pain and a dangerously high heart rate.

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Episode 6 Michelle and Hannah help a man having a devastating anxiety attack in the street; trainee Shane takes the lead for the first time at the scene of a car crash.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.title: The Supervet

programme.title: The Supervet

programme.desc: S15 E5 — Ted, Jess & Ruby Ruby the dachshund is rushed in after being run over by a car. Nine-year-old schnauzer Jess is booked in for spinal surgery. Pint-size shih tzu Ted has been injured at home. A CT scan shows that Ted has a broken right humerus.
programme.title: The Supervet

programme.title: The Supervet

programme.title: The Supervet
